sources.author: MDN contributors / Mozilla
sources.title: Window: devicePixelRatio property
sources.version: 公开在线Web API参考；页面未锁定历史revision
sources.published: 页面独立发布日期未核实
sources.sections: Value / Correcting resolution in a canvas / page zoom
sources.evidence: DPR为物理像素与CSS像素比，页面zoom影响DPR；canvas CSS尺寸与backing大小分离
sources.limitations: MDN解释性参考；不代替目标Electron版本実测或Babylon渲染缩放配置

sources.author: MDN contributors / Mozilla
sources.title: Element: getBoundingClientRect()
sources.evidence: DOMRect在视口坐标中的CSS像素可供将渲染像素换算为屏幕浮层位置
sources.limitations: 滚动/变换/缩放与rect定义须用当前运行时实测，未验证Electron

sources.author: MDN contributors / Mozilla
sources.title: WebGL best practices
sources.evidence: 非整数DPR可引入锯齿与精度问题，不能假定backing像素永远恰好等于CSS乘DPR
sources.limitations: 性能建议非Babylon具体版本保障

sources.author: Alastair Campbell; Chuck Adams; Rachael Bradley Montgomery; Michael Cooper; Andrew Kirkpatrick (editors)
sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.sections: SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), SC 2.5.7 Dragging Movements
sources.evidence: 可操作目标24×24 CSS px或满足例外；不能只提供拖拽动作
sources.limitations: Procet提出全部目标≥24×24为更严格内部候选策略；未开展WCAG符合性审计；字体≤12px是内部约束

sources.author: Patrick H. Lauke; Robert Flack (editors), W3C
sources.title: Pointer Events Level 3
sources.evidence: 拖动期间捕获/取消是输入生命期事件，不等于领域提交
sources.limitations: 目标Electron内核和Pointer Events L3支持需独立测试

sources.author: Babylon.js maintainers
sources.title: Babylon.js Mesh Transformations
sources.version: 在线官方文档，未锁定产品依赖版本
sources.evidence: 显示局部与世界坐标/手性不同，Renderer投影不能成为CAD尺寸真值
sources.limitations: 未直接实读Vector3.Project实现源码，投影细节必须锁定项目所用Babylon版本复测
